metadata.title: Where Is the Star Rating in Melivra? | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
In Melivra’s player, find the star-rating row below the progress bar and above the playback controls. The captured example shows five stars.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator capture of Melivra 1.0.8+145 with repository-authored demonstration metadata and original procedural cover art. No taps, rating changes, saved results, playback or speed demonstration is shown. The rating and displayed times are seeded examples. This is not a live recording, and the video has no audio.
